{{Youmay|the technology device|the [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|Star Destroyer]]}}
[[File:R5-D4_bad_motivator.png|thumb|right|250px|A blown motivator on a R5 astromech droid]]
{{Quote|This R2 unit has a bad motivator.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''motivator''' or '''motivator unit''' was an internal mechanism that was primarily used in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that allowed them to be able to move. The motivator converted energy into mechanical motion.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

A standard type of motivator found in [[Service droid/Legends|Service droids]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] was the [[FV50]] unit. [[Binary motivator]]s were used in starships such as [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s.
